question: Should this component expose arbitrary registered OpenClaw scopes through a public API and Kconfig setting, rather than retaining its current empty-scope connection contract?
rationale: This is a durable public API, configuration, and authentication-behavior decision; the supplied PR body and discussion contain no maintainer approval for that product contract.

options.title: Keep the existing contract
options.body: Decline arbitrary scope registration in this component and retain the current empty-scope behavior.

options.title: Accept scope registration
options.body: Approve the public API after the signed-scope consistency defect is repaired and real interoperability evidence is provided.

options.title: Define a narrower scope policy
options.body: Specify a supported scope vocabulary or fixed authorization model before accepting an implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep the existing contract
recommendation.body: Decline arbitrary scope registration in this component and retain the current empty-scope behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: No history-backed current-main owner could be identified from the available read-only evidence.
